tenantPoints: Hard isolation boundary: tokens, namespaces, sites, proxies, configs, secrets and notification channels belong to exactly one tenant and are never visible from another.
Users are global accounts. A role binding (role + optional namespace + optional sites) is what gives a user access to this tenant.
Platform admins, created by "spnr admin init", can act in every tenant.
intro.namespaceTitle: Namespace = an environment or business line inside one tenant
namespacePoints: Sites, proxies, config items, secrets, API tokens and policies belong to a namespace; endpoint groups, identity types, identities and accounts belong to a site.
A binding pinned to namespace A cannot see the sites, identities or credentials of namespace B, and can be narrowed further to single sites.
Revealing a credential payload additionally needs the identity:reveal permission.
intro.mapping: In short: a team is a tenant, and a project or environment inside that team is a namespace.
